# itch.io

> > itch.io is an open marketplace for independent digital creators, focusing on indie games with flexible pricing, distribution tools, and community features.

Founded by leafo, itch.io serves as a platform for indie game developers to publish, sell, and share their work. The site supports game jams like Ludum Dare, offers customizable storefronts, and provides tools for developers to manage downloads, analytics, and pricing.

## Key Topics

- indie games
- game distribution
- digital marketplace
- game jams (Ludum Dare)
- developer tools
- game discovery
- flexible pricing
- analytics
- devlogs
- platform updates
- download management
- game browsing
- community features
- independent creators

## Platform Features & Updates

- [Updated way to browse games](https://itch.io/updates/updated-way-to-browse-games): Browse page UI update with improved game discovery by leafo
- [Introducing the games feed!](https://itch.io/updates/introducing-the-games-feed): New personalized games feed feature announcement by leafo
- [Say hello to the new browse & search pages!](https://itch.io/updates/say-hello-to-the-new-browse-search-pages): Redesigned browse & search for 250+ games by leafo
- [Browse Games](https://itch.io/updates/browse-games): New game browsing feature for discovery by leafo
- [Sell files at different price points](https://itch.io/updates/sell-files-at-different-price-points): New feature: individual file pricing tiers by leafo
- [More analytics and updated designs](https://itch.io/updates/more-analytics-and-updated-designs): Enhanced analytics & homepage redesign update by leafo
- [You can now request your download URLs to be resent to your email address](https://itch.io/updates/you-can-now-request-your-download-urls-to-be-resent-to-your-email-address): Feature announcement: email resend for download URLs by leafo
